_readme: Hand-edited picks for the Media Diet (homepage #md-reading / #md-listening and /media-diet/). No sync script touches this file.
type 'article' shows on the READING shelf next to the books. Every other type (podcast | episode | album | song | video) shows on the LISTENING shelf.

Fields: type, title, creator (show, artist or publication; 'Author · Publication' works), url (https only; leave it out if you don't have the real link and the card shows without one), date (YYYY-MM-DD, or YYYY-MM when only the month is known).
Optional: image (https URL to square cover art), note (one line, what grabbed you).
Episode links: the Spotify share link for the episode is best. Entries here that point at a show's home page are waiting for the exact episode link.
